chapter: Willie Cornish: war service and personal history
title: Pension questioning about Willie's war service
summary: She recalls his stories of the Philippines and Cuba and the long, repeated sessions at the veterans office to get her pension.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh my husband said when he went to war, he told me he went on the Philippine island. He went all out in Cubial. He went to all them places and lived on the island and everything. Could he ask me? Oh my God, when they asked me that up there where I went to the vet and be... I stayed there so long until I just got sick. They sure can ask you some questions. Mm-hmm. Oh, I went for three solid weeks every other day. And every time I go, I'd get a new number. First time I went, I got 21. Next time I went, they gave me number 2. Next time I went, I had number 39. Sometime I'd be coming home way late, even 3 o'clock. Sometime 4 o'clock. And we'd be packing. And some of them women, they couldn't tell you when their husband died. And couldn't tell you when they got married. He said, well, what kind of women is y'all? Why they call it? He told them that. Well, you tell me you don't know when you married a man. Wasn't that foolish?
